text: つかまえた　ポケモンを　どうしようと　かってだろ！

structure.jp: つかまえた　ポケモンを

structure.en: is our own business, isn't it!

patterns.name: 〜ようと
patterns.explanation: A verb in its 'let's' form plus と means 'no matter what one does'. どう　しようと = 'whatever we do with them'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかまえた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: The verb right before ポケモン describes it. つかまえた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon we caught'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is a rough short form of だろう, pushing the listener to agree. かってだろ = 'it's up to us, isn't it!'
